brief.cleartextBlocked: Blocked because the server URL uses http://. Check Server settings.
brief.certificateUntrusted: The server's certificate isn't trusted by this device. Check Server settings.
brief.hostnameMismatch: The server's certificate doesn't cover this address. Check Server settings.
brief.timeout: The server didn't respond in time. Try again in a moment.
brief.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check that it's running.
brief.unknown: Can't reach the server right now.

full.cleartextBlocked: This device blocked the connection because the URL uses plain http://. Switch the server to https:// — a reverse proxy can issue a certificate for a LAN-only hostname with no ports open.
full.certificateUntrusted: The server's certificate isn't trusted by this device. Best fix: give the server a real certificate — a reverse proxy can issue one for a LAN-only hostname with no ports open. Or install your own CA under Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials, which trusts it for every app on the device, not just Lyftr.
full.hostnameMismatch: The server's certificate doesn't cover this address. Reissue it with this hostname or IP listed in the certificate's Subject Alternative Name (SAN).
full.timeout: The server didn't respond in time. Check that it's running and reachable from this device.
full.unreachable: Couldn't connect to the server. Check the URL and that the backend is running.
full.unknownWeb: Can't reach the server. Check the URL, that the backend is running, and that it allows this app's origin (CORS).
full.unknownNative: Can't reach the server. Check the URL and that the backend is running and reachable from this device.

list.unreadable: The server sent something we could not read.
